name: Sample
description: Examples of every kind of rule; not meant to be used as is.
_comment: Sample text transformation file for merging another regional client's text into the client's sheets. Not used unless added to the settings.

Keys are regular expressions matched against sheet names (case-insensitive, e.g. "^Item$", "^quest/"); every matching entry applies, in file order. Keys starting with _ are ignored, as are "name" and "description" with a string value (shown in the settings).
A sheet's string columns, sorted by their offset, are numbered 0, 1, 2...; report.json in the ExcelMerge cache folder lists them with a sample of each.
"<index>": <source index> takes the column from that string column of the other client's sheet; "<index>": null keeps the client's own language in it.

"<index>": [steps] or "*": [steps] (every string column) changes the text of each cell. Steps run in order on "<merged text>\u001F<client text>", with the merged text empty where it is the same as the client's:
["<pattern>", "<replacement>"] replaces every match (ECMAScript regular expression, per Unicode character; $1, $& in the replacement; \n and \uXXXX escapes work in both).
Afterwards, the cell is the text before the first \u001F if one is left, otherwise all of it; so steps that match nothing change nothing.
Line breaks are \n; other macros are single characters from U+F0000 on, and must stay whole: keep or drop all of one side's macros, never repeat one.
Cells kept in the client's language (below, and quest phrases typed in /say) are not changed by steps.
"keep": [{"row": 12}, {"key": "TEXT_..._000", "column": 1}] keeps cells in the client's language; "unkeep" undoes it. "key" looks up the text of string column 0.
Without "column", the cell is in string column 1 if string column 0 holds text keys (only A-Z, 0-9, _; quest and dialogue sheets), otherwise in string column 0.

Korean Mamool Ja names, only in cells whose English names a Ja: (syllable)(syllable without final)쟈[쟈] -> the second syllable gets ㄹ as final, and 쟈 becomes 자; an optional 족/풍 and particle may follow.

^(Item|BNpcName|PlaceName)$._comment: Names as "merged (client)": the client's text alone when the merged one is empty, and once when both are the same.

^Item$._comment: Item string column 3 is the name the English client shows; string column 0 is the singular used in sentences.

^quest/._comment: Quest text: the merged text, then the client's text on the next line.

^(ENpcResident|EObjName)$._comment: Trims spaces around the merged name.
